mentions.name: Experimental HPC batch system
mentions.description: This is a prototype of an experimental HPC-style batch system that uses distributed Erlang for the control plane and relies on systemd transient units for much of the heavy lifting, inspired by HTCondor and Joyent's Manta.
mentions.source_excerpt: Another prototype, for an experimental HPC-ish batch system. Using distributed Erlang for the control plane, and doing a lot of the heavy lifting with systemd transient units. Very much inspired by HTCondor as well as Joyent's (RIP to a real one) Manta.
